title: LORD, WIN THE VICTORIES I CANNOT WIN ON MY OWN
text: Beloved, if this message finds you and the spirit of God begins to stir your heart, I want you to take a moment and share this [music] prayer. Share it with someone who has been fighting battles they cannot win in their own strength. Share it with that brother who has been struggling. Share it with that sister who has been standing but her knees are buckling. There are victories that God has ordained for you that will never come by your wisdom, your strategy or your strength. And when you encounter such battles, the only thing that saves you is the divine intervention of the most high God. So share this with someone right now because what we're about to do in this place is not ordinary. We're about to engage heaven in a dimension where God himself steps into your battles [music] and fights for you. Can I talk to somebody today? I want you to understand something that will revolutionize your prayer life and your Christian work. There is a principle in the kingdom that many believers have not yet activated. And until you activate it, you will continue to struggle with battles that were meant to be won by divine intervention. The Bible says in Zechariah 4:6, "Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, says the Lord of hosts." You see, when you come to a place where you recognize that there are certain victories that your intelligence cannot secure, there are certain breakthroughs that your connections cannot produce, there are certain doors that your qualifications cannot open. You have arrived at the place where God can show himself strong on your behalf. The problem with many believers is that they want to win every battle with their own wisdom. They want to negotiate their way through every challenge. But I have come to tell you tonight that there are battles that God has specifically designed to be won by him alone. So that when the victory comes, all glory will return to heaven. I want you to look at the life of Jehoshaphat in 2 Chronicles chapter 20. Here was a king who received intelligence that three armies were coming against him. Now Jehoshaphat was a man who had wisdom. He had military strategy. He had resources. But when he heard the report of the multitude coming against him, the Bible says he feared and set himself to seek the Lord. He didn't run to his war council first. He didn't start strategizing with his generals. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah. And the people gathered to ask help from the Lord. And when they gathered, listen to what Jehoshaphat had prayed. He said, "Oh Lord God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven? And do you not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? And in your hand is there not power and might so that no one is able to withstand you?" Do you see the foundation of this prayer? Before he presented his problem, he established who God is. He reminded himself and reminded heaven that the God he serves is not a limited God. He's not a God who needs human assistance. He's the God who rules over kingdoms. The God in whose hand is power and might. Then Jehoshaphat said something that I want you to catch. He said, "We have no power against this great multitude that is coming against us. Nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon you." Somebody shout, "Our eyes are upon you." You see, this is the place of honest consecration. This is a place where you stop pretending that you have it all figured out. This is the place where you tell God the truth. Lord, I don't have the power. I don't have the strategy. I don't know what to do, but I'm looking to you. And what happened? The spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel and he stood in the assembly and said, "Thus says [music] the Lord to you. Do not be afraid, not dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours, but God's." Can I tell you that the same word that came to Jehoshaphat is coming to you tonight. That business challenge that has kept you awake at night, the battle is not yours, is God's. That family situation that has defied every human solution, the battle is not yours, it's God's. That health report that came back and shook your entire foundation, the battle is not yours, it's God's. But here's what you must understand. For God to fight your battles, you must position yourself correctly. You cannot be living in deliberate disobedience [music] and expect God to show up as your divine warrior. You cannot be harboring bitterness and unforgiveness in your heart and expect the God of armies to march on your behalf. You cannot be walking in pride and self-sufficiency and expect the King of glory to demonstrate [music] his power in your situation. There is a preparation that attracts divine intervention. The children of Israel when they got to the Red Sea, they were trapped. Pharaoh's army behind them, mountains on both sides, the Red Sea in front of them, and they began to cry out to Moses. Why did you bring us here to die when there are enough graves in Egypt? But Moses said something that I want you to hear. He said, "Do not be afraid. Stand still and see the salvation of the Lord, which you will accomplish for you today. For the Egyptians whom you see today, you shall see again no more forever. The Lord will fight for you and you shall hold your peace. The Lord will fight for you and you shall hold your peace. Somebody needs to understand what it means to hold your peace. It doesn't mean you become passive. It doesn't mean you stop praying. It means you cease from the anxiety. You cease from the manipulation. You cease from running ahead of God with your own solutions. You enter into a rest that says, "God, I trust you completely. I'm not going to force doors. I'm not going to manipulate circumstances. I'm going to let you be God. And when Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night and made the sea into dry land. Do you see what happened? God used a natural element, wind, [music] to create a supernatural deliverance. This is what God does when he fights for you. He takes things that are already in existence and reorganizes them for your favor. He takes people who didn't even know they were going to help you and positions them at your point of need. He takes circumstances that look completely hopeless and turns them into testimonies that bring him glory. Now, I want to take you to the book of Exodus chapter 14. But I want to show you another dimension. When the children of Israel crossed over and Pharaoh's army tried to follow them, the Bible says the Lord looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud and he troubled the army of the Egyptians. He took off their chariot wheels so that they drove them with difficulty. Listen to what the Egyptians said. Let us flee from the face of Israel for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians. When God begins to fight for you, even your enemies will recognize it. they will step back and say there's something different about this one. There's a hand of protection over their life. There's a divine favor that we cannot penetrate. This is what happens when you stop fighting in your own strength and you allow the captain of the host to take charge of your battles. Can I show you something in the book of Joshua? When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted his eyes and looked and behold a man stood opposite him with his sword drawn in his hand. And Joshua went to him and said, "Are you for us or for our adversaries?" And he said, "No, but as commander of the army of the Lord, I have now come." And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and worshiped and said to him, "What does my Lord say to his servant?" You see, Joshua asked the wrong question. He wanted to know, "Are you on our side?" But the commander said, "No, I haven't come to take sides. I've come to take over. I haven't come to support your agenda. I've come to establish heaven's agenda. And when Joshua recognized who was standing before him. He didn't argue. He didn't negotiate. He fell on his face and said, "What does my Lord say to his servant?" He positioned himself as a servant under divine command. This is what many believers are missing. They want God to endorse their plans instead of surrendering to God's plans. They want God to fight for their agenda instead of aligning with heaven's agenda. But when you come to the place where you say, "Lord, not my will but yours be done. Not my strategy but your strategy. Not my timing but your timing." That's when heaven's armies are released on your behalf. I want you to understand something about spiritual warfare. There are three dimensions of conflict that every believer must recognize. There are battles you fight. There are battles you watch. And there are battles that are fought in the realm of the spirit before you even become aware of them. The battles you fight are the ones where God has equipped you, trained you, and given you grace to engage. Like when David killed the lion and the bear, those were training battles that prepared him for Golth. But there are battles you watch. These are the battles where your only assignment is to stand [music] in faith and see the salvation of the Lord. You don't lift a sword. You don't throw a stone. You simply position yourself in worship, in prayer, in consecration, and you watch God move. This is what happened at Jericho. The children of Israel didn't break down those walls with battering rams. They marched, they shouted, they blew trumpets, and God brought the walls down. Then there are battles that are fought for you in the heavenly realm before you even know about them. Like in the book of Daniel chapter 10 when Daniel had been praying for 21 days and the angel finally appeared and said, "From the first day that you set your heart to understand and to humble yourself before God, your words were heard and I have come because of your words. But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withtood me 21 days." There was a battle raging in the spiritual realm while Daniel was fasting and praying. Daniel didn't see it. Daniel didn't know the details. But because he remained consistent in consecration, the archangel Michael came to assist and the breakthrough [music] was released. This is what I'm trying to tell you. While you are standing, while you are praying, while you are believing God, there are battles being won on your behalf in dimensions you cannot see. But here's the key. You must maintain your position. You cannot give up on day 20. You cannot quit because the answer didn't come in your expected timeline. You must understand that delay is not denial. The fact that you haven't seen the manifestation doesn't mean heaven hasn't heard you. Sometimes the delay is because there's a war in the spiritual realm and God is clearing the pathway for your blessing to reach you. Now let me take you to 2 Kings chapter 6. The king of Syria was waring against Israel. And [music] every time he set a trap, Elisha the prophet would warn the king of Israel. This happened again and again until the Syrian king became furious. He thought there was a spy in his camp. But one of his servants said, "No, my [music] lord, O king. But Elisha the prophet who is in Israel tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom." So the king sent horses and chariots and a great army, and they came by night and surrounded the city. When Elisha's servant woke up early in the morning and saw the army surrounding them, he panicked. "Alas, my master, what shall we do?" And Elisha said, "Do not fear, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them." Now, catch this. Elisha didn't see anything different than what his servant saw. There was still an army surrounding them. The circumstances hadn't changed, but Elisha's perspective was different. He was looking at reality from heaven's dimension. Then Elisha prayed and said, "Lord, I pray. Open his eyes that he may see." And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw. And behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha. Somebody needs their eyes open tonight. You've been looking at your situation with natural eyes, and all you can see is the army of impossibility surrounding you. All you can see is the financial crisis, the marital breakdown, the medical diagnosis, the career setback. But if God would open your spiritual eyes right now, you would see that you are not alone. You would see that the mountain is full of horses and chariots of fire. You would see that the angels of the Lord are encamped around those who fear him. The psalmist said in Psalm 34:7, "The angel of the Lord encamps all around those who fear him and delivers them. Not some of those who fear him. All around those who fear him, you are surrounded by a divine garrison. You are protected by heaven's military. And when God decides to fight for you, no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Let me tell you what happened next in that story. The Syrian army came down to capture Elisha. And Elisha prayed, "Strike these people, I pray, with blindness." And God struck them with blindness. Then Elisha led them to Samaria, right into the hands of the king of Israel. When they arrived, Elisha prayed again, "Lord, open the eyes of these men that they may see." And when their eyes were opened, they realized they were trapped in the city of their enemies. The king of Israel said to Elisha, "My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?" And Elisha said, "You shall not kill them. Set food and water before them that they may eat and drink and go to their master." And they prepared a great feast for them. And after they ate and drank, he sent them away, and they went to their master. And the Syrian raiders came no more into the land of Israel. Do you see what God did? He didn't just deliver Elisha. He turned enemies [music] into confused wanderers. He didn't just protect Israel. He stopped future attacks. When God wins a victory for you, it's comprehensive. It's not just for today, it secures tomorrow. It's not just defensive. It's offensive. It doesn't just protect you. It intimidates the enemy from ever trying again. Now, I want to take you to a place of prayer. But I need to establish something first. There is a difference between praying for God to help you fight and praying for God to fight for you. When you pray for God to help you, you're still assuming the primary responsibility. You are asking for assistance, for strength, for wisdom. And these are good prayers. But when you pray for God to fight for you, you're transferring the ownership of the battle to heaven. You're saying, "Lord, this is beyond me. This is too big for me. I'm stepping aside and I'm inviting you to step in." This is what Hannah did. She didn't just pray for a child. She wept in bitterness of soul. She poured out her heart before the Lord. And when Eli the priest saw her, he thought she was drunk because her lips were moving, but no sound was coming out. She was in a dimension of prayer where human language was insufficient. She was groaning in the spirit. And when Eli confronted her, she said, "No, my Lord, I am a woman of sorrowful spirit. I have drunk neither wine nor intoxicating drink, but have poured out my soul before the Lord. I have poured out my soul before the Lord." This is the level of prayer we need to enter tonight. Not casual prayer, not convenient prayer, not prayer that fits into your schedule, but prayer that pours out your soul, prayer that travails, prayer that refuses to let go until heaven responds. And what happened to Hannah? Eli said to her, "Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant your petition which you have asked of him." And she went her way and at her face was no longer sad. Why? because something shifted in the spiritual realm. Before she saw the manifestation, before she conceived, before she held Samuel in her arms, she received an assurance from heaven that her prayer was heard. This is what I'm decreeing over your life tonight. Before you see the manifestation, you're going to receive the assurance. Before the breakthrough becomes visible, you're going to know in your spirit that heaven has moved. You're going to eat and your countenance is going to change because faith has anchored your soul. Let me show you one more thing before we pray. In the book of Acts chapter 12, Peter was in prison. Herod had already killed James and now Peter was next. The Bible says Peter was sleeping between two soldiers bound with two chains and the guards before the door were keeping the prison. Humanly speaking, there was no way out. But the Bible says in verse 5, Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church. Constant prayer, not one prayer meeting, not a casual mention, constant persistent unrelenting prayer was being offered to God for him by the church. And that night, an angel of the Lord stood by him and a light shone in the prison. The angel struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, "Arise quickly." And his chains fell off his hands. Listen to this detail. The chains fell off. Peter didn't break them. The guards didn't remove them. The chains fell off. Because when God shows up, bondages have to release you. When God shows up, limitations have to surrender. When God shows up, what held you captive has no choice but to let you go. The angel said to Peter, "Guard yourself and tie on your sandals, put on your garment and follow me." And Peter followed him, thinking he was seeing a vision. They passed the first guard post, then the second, and they came to the iron gates that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord. The gate opened by itself. Nobody pushed it. Nobody had a key. It opened of its own accord. Because when God is fighting for you, doors open supernaturally. Now let's pray. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace tonight. Not as one who has all the answers, not as one who can navigate this by my own wisdom, but as your childh who desperately needs [music] you to fight for me. Lord, I confess that there are battles in my life right now that are beyond my capacity. There are situations I have tried to fix and they have only gotten more complicated. There are doors I have knocked on and they remain shut. There are challenges I have strategized against and they have only multiplied. So tonight Lord, I'm transferring ownership of these battles to you. I am stepping aside from my own efforts, my own manipulation, my own anxiety, and I am inviting you, commander of heaven's armies, ancient of days, the God who never loses a battle. I am inviting you to step into my warfare. Lord, win the victories I cannot [music] win on my own. Fight the battles that are too big for my strength. Open the doors that are beyond my reach. Dismantle the conspiracies that have been plotted against my destiny. I decree in the name of Jesus that every pharaoh that has been chasing me, every enemy that has been pursuing my peace, every force that has been contending with my progress, the Lord is stepping into that battle tonight. And just as you troubled the Egyptian army, just as you took off their chariot wheels, I decree that you are troubling every force that is contending with my advancement. I decree confusion in the camp of my enemies. I decree that their weapons are malfunctioning. I decree that their strategies are backfiring. Lord, I thank you that you are the God who makes crooked places straight. You are the God who makes rough places smooth. You are the God who brings down every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. And I am standing on your word tonight that says, "No weapon formed against me shall prosper. And every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I shall condemn." Father, I pray for supernatural intervention in my finances. I pray that you would fight the battle of lack in my life. I decree that Jehovah Gyra, my provider, is showing up in my economic situation. I decree that you are opening windows of heaven over my life that no man can shut. I decree that you are bringing me into the wealth of the sinner that is stored up for the just. I decree unexpected income, surprising opportunities and supernatural provision. Lord, win the victory in my health. I decree that by your stripes I am healed. I decree that every affliction, every diagnosis, every symptom that has been attacking my body, you are fighting that battle for me. I command sickness to leave. I command pain to go. I command every abnormality to be corrected by the power of the Holy [music] Spirit. I decree that I shall live and not die. I decree that I shall declare the works of the Lord. I decree divine health and supernatural strength. Father, I pray for my family. Lord, fight the battles in my home that I cannot fight. Deliver my children from every trap of the enemy. Restore my marriage where there has been division. Heal relationships that have been broken. Remove every spirit of strife, every spirit of misunderstanding, every spirit of rebellion. I decree that as for me and my house, we shall serve the Lord. I decree that my family is covered by the blood of Jesus. I decree angelic protection over every member of my household. Lord, I pray for my career and my purpose. I decree that you are fighting for my promotion. I decree that you are opening doors of opportunity that no man can shut. I decree that I am being positioned in places of influence. I decree that the favor of God is going before me, making crooked places straight. I decree that every limitation, every ceiling, every barrier that has stopped my progress, you are breaking through on my behalf. I speak to every mountain in my life right now in the name of Jesus. I command you to be removed and be cast into the sea. I speak to every red sea situation. I command you to part. I speak to every Jericho wall. I command you to fall. I speak to every lion and bear that has been intimidating me. I decree that the God of David is giving me victory. Father, I thank you that you are the God who makes a way where there is no way. You are the God who speaks and it is done. You are the God who commands and it stands fast. You are the God who numbers the stars and calls them by name. Yet you know the number of hairs on my head. You are the God who holds the waters in the palm of your hand. Yet you are mindful of me. I decree that every battle that has defied human solution is being resolved by divine intervention. I decree that what looked impossible is becoming possible. I decree that what looked permanent is being overthrown. I decree that what looked final is being reversed. Lord, just as you sent an angel to Peter's prison, I pray that you will send your angels to every prison situation in my life. Break the chains of limitation. Break the chains of death. Break the chains of addiction. Break the chains of fear. Break the [music] chains of depression. Break the chains of stagnation. Let those chains fall off right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that gates are opening of their own accord. I decree that supernatural access is being granted to me. I decree that I'm walking through barriers that used to stop me. I decree that the iron gates of resistance are swinging open because the God of heaven is fighting for me. Father, I thank you for every prayer warrior who has stood with me. I thank you for the church that prayed for Peter. I thank you for the intercessors who have been holding up my hands. I decree that their prayers are creating a shield of protection around my life. I decree that their intercession is releasing angelic activity on my behalf. And now, Lord, I make a covenant with you today. As you fight for me, as you win these victories, I will give you all the glory. I will not boast in my own strength. I will not credit my own wisdom. I will declare that salvation belongs to the Lord. I will testify that you are a mighty warrior. I will tell the world that my God fights for me. I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I seal my life with the blood of Jesus. I seal my family with the blood of Jesus. I seal my destiny with the blood of Jesus. And I decree that from this moment forward I am walking in victory because the captain of the host has taken command of my battles. In the mighty powerful undefeated name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth I have prayed and every spirit in agreement says amen. Amen. And amen.
